name: Subconscious noticer — daily Pass A + Pass B scan
notes: Single daily noticer pass (Pass A inward pattern detection + Pass B outward opportunity scouting). Runs early enough that the day's concerns are ready by the time the proposers fire at 05:00. Architecture says 2-4x/day eventually; starting daily to keep cost predictable and build signal-volume baseline. Output: concerns_register + belief_updates + escalations to dayflow.
